Bug_Title: BC: instanceof will always return false (BC_IMPOSSIBLE_INSTANCEOF)
Bug_Details:
This instanceof test will always return false. Although this is safe, make sure it isn't
an indication of some misunderstanding or some other logic error.
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the generated code by assigning an Integer object to a variable of type Object and then performing an instanceof check against the String class. Since an Integer can never be an instance of String, the check will always return false.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug method which contains the bug. The bug is triggered when the instanceof check is performed, which will always return false because an Integer cannot be an instance of String. The test expects the result to be 'true', which causes the test to fail, thus triggering the bug.
